enemy_traits.1: On every third attack, add 3 damage as the rays converge.
enemy_traits.2: On turn 1 of each three-turn cycle, gain 4 Ward instead of attacking.
enemy_traits.3: On the second step, gain 5 Ward instead of attacking; on the third step, add 3 damage.
enemy_traits.4: Immediately before attacking, remove up to 3 player Ward.
enemy_traits.6: On feeding turns, remove up to 4 player Ward and gain that much Ward instead of attacking.
enemy_traits.7: On rooting turns, gain 5 Ward instead of attacking. After attacking, heal 3 HP if no direct card attack damaged its HP this turn.
enemy_traits.8: Every attack has 2 additional hits as the voices sing together.
enemy_traits.9: Every second attack deals 1 extra damage as the wings open fully.
enemy_traits.10: If the player is carrying a card with Keep, add 2 damage.
enemy_traits.11: Every third attack ignores up to 3 player Ward; any remaining Ward works normally.
enemy_traits.12: After every third attack, Banish the last physical card played this turn for this fight, if it is still in discard.
enemy_traits.13: After attacking, remove its remaining Burn and gain Ward equal to the Burn removed, up to 3.
enemy_traits.14: After each second attack, flip all player cards currently carried with Keep.
enemy_traits.15: Every third attack sweeps twice instead of once.
enemy_traits.16: At the start of the player turn, reveal the draw pile's top card. If that physical card is played this turn, add 3 damage.
enemy_traits.17: If the player ends with unspent mana, heal 2 HP after attacking.
enemy_traits.18: If its attack deals any HP damage, the same attack gains one final 2-damage hit.
enemy_traits.19: On wallow turns, gain 5 Ward; the next fixed turn is its charge.
enemy_traits.20: After each third attack, return the top card of the player's discard to the bottom of their draw pile.
enemy_traits.21: On blooming turns, heal 3 HP instead of attacking; on the following turn, add 3 damage.
enemy_traits.22: If the player is below half maximum HP, add 2 damage.
enemy_traits.23: If the player played the same number of cards as on their previous turn, add 2 damage.
enemy_traits.24: On each third attack, add one hit for each unused player mana, up to 2 extra hits.
enemy_traits.25: After attacking, gain 2 Ward for each card the player carried with Keep, up to 4 Ward.
enemy_traits.26: After every second attack, move the last physical card the player played this turn from discard to the top of their draw pile, if still there.
enemy_traits.27: After every second attack, gain 3 Ward from freshly pooled wax.
enemy_traits.28: If its previous attack damaged player HP, remove up to 3 player Ward before this attack.
enemy_traits.29: On drinking turns, heal 4 HP instead of attacking.
enemy_traits.30: If a direct card attack had at least 8 damage after bonuses but before Ward this turn, add one 2-damage hit to its attack.
enemy_traits.31: Each winding turn gains 2 more Ward than the last, capped at 6.
enemy_traits.32: After each second attack, the player must choose one Kept card to release to discard, if any.
enemy_traits.33: If the player drew cards using card effects this turn, add 2 damage.
enemy_traits.34: After every third attack, put the top card of the player's draw pile into discard, face unchanged.
enemy_traits.35: If at least 2 direct card attacks hit it this turn, add 2 damage.
enemy_traits.36: If the player carried any card with Keep from the previous turn, add 2 damage.
enemy_traits.37: Before every second attack, remove up to 4 player Ward.
enemy_traits.38: If the player carried at least 2 cards with Keep, add 3 damage.
enemy_traits.39: After attacking, gain 2 Ward for each Flip effect the player used this turn, capped at 4.
enemy_traits.40: If its attack removes at least 3 player Ward, heal 2 HP afterward.
enemy_traits.41: On tending turns, heal 2 HP and gain 3 Ward instead of attacking.
enemy_traits.42: Its second attack has 2 hits and its third has 3 hits; each hit is 3 damage.
enemy_traits.43: If its base hit is fully absorbed by Ward, add two 1-damage hits to the same attack.
enemy_traits.44: If the player removed enemy Ward using a card effect this turn, add 2 damage.
enemy_traits.45: Before every second attack, remove up to 2 player Ward for each card kept this turn, capped at 4.
enemy_traits.46: After an attack that damages player HP, gain 3 Ward.
enemy_traits.47: If the player played no Flip effect this turn, remove up to 2 player Ward before attacking.
enemy_traits.48: After every second attack, move the top card of the player's draw pile to its bottom.
enemy_traits.49: Immediately before attacking, remove up to 5 player Ward.
enemy_traits.50: After an attack that deals no player HP damage, gain 5 Ward.
enemy_traits.51: Every third attack gains two additional 2-damage hits.
enemy_traits.52: On crouching turns, gain 4 Ward; the following attack ignores up to 2 player Ward.
enemy_traits.53: After each second attack, remove all its remaining Burn.
enemy_traits.54: If its attack deals HP damage, the player draws 1 fewer card at the next turn's normal draw.
enemy_traits.55: If the player played no direct card attack this turn, add 3 damage.
enemy_traits.56: If the player played exactly 2 cards this turn, add 2 damage.
enemy_traits.57: On closing turns, gain 7 Ward instead of attacking.
enemy_traits.58: After each third attack, the player discards 1 chosen card carried with Keep, if any.
enemy_traits.59: If the player gained at least 5 Ward this turn, gain 3 Ward after attacking.
enemy_traits.60: If the first card played matches the pair of last turn's first card, add 3 damage.
enemy_traits.61: On stealing turns, Banish the top draw-pile card for this fight instead of attacking.
enemy_traits.62: If the player healed HP this turn, heal 3 HP after attacking.
enemy_traits.63: If the player banished a card this turn, gain 4 Ward after attacking.
enemy_traits.64: On refrain turns, heal 5 HP instead of attacking if no direct card attack damaged its HP this turn.
enemy_traits.65: If the player used Flip at least twice this turn, add 3 damage.
enemy_traits.66: After each second attack, gain 5 Ward if the player has no Mark on it.
enemy_traits.67: Each attack gains one extra 1-damage hit per direct card attack played this turn, capped at 3 extra hits.
enemy_traits.68: If the player used a direct attack from the pair that last damaged its HP on the previous turn, add 3 damage.
enemy_traits.69: If the player used a direct card attack this turn, raise its base damage to that last attack's pre-Ward amount, to a maximum of 8 and minimum of 3.
enemy_traits.70: After attacking, gain 1 Ward per card left in the player's hand, capped at 4.
enemy_traits.71: If the player ends with unspent mana, remove up to 4 player Ward before attacking.
enemy_traits.72: If a direct card attack damaged its HP this turn, add 2 damage.
enemy_traits.73: Before every second attack, remove 2 player Ward per card kept this turn, capped at 6.
enemy_traits.74: If the player played 3 or more cards this turn, add an extra 2-damage hit after the base hit.
enemy_traits.75: After attacking, gain Ward equal to the player Ward that absorbed that attack, capped at 4.
enemy_traits.76: On swelling turns, heal 2 HP and remove its remaining Burn instead of attacking.
enemy_traits.77: If its attack is fully absorbed by Ward, heal 2 HP afterward.
enemy_traits.78: Every second attack ignores all player Ward.
enemy_traits.79: If the player used Keep this turn, add one additional hit.
enemy_traits.80: If no direct card attack damaged its HP this turn, gain 4 Ward after attacking.
enemy_traits.81: After attacking, turn one chosen card carried with Keep to its opposite face; the player chooses, if any.
enemy_traits.82: If a direct card attack removed all of its Ward this turn, add one extra 3-damage hit.
enemy_traits.83: On harvesting turns, heal up to 4 HP and gain Ward equal to HP actually healed instead of attacking.
enemy_traits.84: After each second attack, one chosen Kept card goes to the bottom of the player's draw pile, if any.
enemy_traits.85: If the player carried at least 1 card from last turn and played none of those carried cards, add 3 damage.
enemy_traits.86: If it still has Burn after the tick, add damage equal to that Burn, capped at 3.
enemy_traits.87: If the player used Scry this turn, gain 5 Ward after attacking.
enemy_traits.88: After attacking, heal HP equal to the player HP damage dealt, capped at 4.
enemy_traits.89: If the player has 3 or fewer Ward before the attack, the attack ignores that Ward.
enemy_traits.90: On each third attack, add 2 damage for each player card carried with Keep, capped at 4.
enemy_traits.91: On basking turns, gain 3 Ward; its next attack adds 3 damage.
enemy_traits.92: After attacking, put one chosen Kept card on top of the player's draw pile, if any.
enemy_traits.93: If the player played 2 consecutive copies of the same pair this turn, add 3 damage.
enemy_traits.94: After each third attack, move up to 2 chosen Kept cards to discard.
enemy_traits.95: If the player returned a card from discard to hand this turn, remove up to 3 player Ward before attacking.
enemy_traits.96: Gain 1 Ward per card the player discarded through card effects this turn, capped at 4, after attacking.
enemy_traits.97: If the player played cards in light → dark → light or dark → light → dark order among their first 3 plays, add 3 damage.
enemy_traits.98: If the player lost HP through a card payment this turn, gain 4 Ward after attacking.
enemy_traits.99: On canopy turns, gain Ward equal to player Ward, capped at 6, instead of attacking.
enemy_traits.100: If the player moved a card to the bottom of the draw pile this turn, add 3 damage.
enemy_traits.101: If the player returned a card from discard this turn, add one additional 3-damage hit.
enemy_traits.102: If the player did not use Scry this turn, its attack ignores up to 3 player Ward.
enemy_traits.103: If the player played no draw effect this turn, remove up to 3 player Ward before attacking.
enemy_traits.104: Every second attack ignores up to 4 player Ward.
enemy_traits.105: If the player ends with 0 mana, gain 3 Ward after attacking.
enemy_traits.106: After an attack that deals player HP damage, put every card currently carried with Keep on top of the draw pile, in the player's chosen order.
enemy_traits.107: If a card with the same pair as last turn's final played card is played this turn, add 2 damage.
enemy_traits.108: Every third attack ignores all player Ward.
enemy_traits.109: On sleeping turns, heal 5 HP instead of attacking.
enemy_traits.110: If the player played 1 or fewer cards this turn, add 2 damage.
